ideas.title: Investigating Voter Record Tampering in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent subpoena of the Minnesota elections office and potential voter record tampering in the state.
questions: What is the extent of the voter record tampering in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the tampering?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale issue with election integrity in Minnesota. By following the money and investigating the subpoena, we may be able to determine the extent of the tampering and those involved.

ideas.title: Exposing Childcare Fraud in the US
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of childcare fraud and potential exploitation of childcare systems across the US.
questions: What is the extent of childcare fraud in the US?
How can childcare systems be better regulated to prevent exploitation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight a larger issue with childcare systems in the US. By analyzing data and investigating recent cases, we may be able to determine the extent of the fraud and provide recommendations for better regulation.
